metadata.description: InsurVoice AI Knowledge Base — Allianz Direct (fictional). 200 realistic insurance FAQs.

faqs.question: Does my home insurance cover water damage from a burst pipe?
faqs.answer: Yes. Burst pipe water damage is covered under your Hausratversicherung as Leitungswasser damage. This covers furniture, electronics, flooring, and personal belongings. Your EUR 250 deductible applies. Note that flooding from external sources like rivers or storms requires separate flood cover.

faqs.question: Is water damage from a leaking roof covered?
faqs.answer: Roof leak damage is covered if caused by a sudden storm event. Gradual wear and tear or lack of maintenance is excluded. You will need to show the leak was caused by an insured event such as storm, hail, or falling objects.

faqs.question: What is Leitungswasser coverage?
faqs.answer: Leitungswasser covers damage caused by water escaping from fixed plumbing, heating, or water-carrying appliances such as washing machines and dishwashers. It includes burst pipes, frozen pipes, and leaking appliances. It does not cover damage from rain entering through open windows.

faqs.question: Does my policy cover fire damage?
faqs.answer: Yes. Fire, smoke, and explosion damage is covered under your contents and building policy. This includes damage to personal belongings, furniture, and built-in fixtures. Arson is excluded unless you are the victim of a third-party fire.

faqs.question: Is a kitchen fire covered?
faqs.answer: Yes. Accidental kitchen fires are covered. This includes damage to appliances, cabinets, and smoke damage throughout the property. Deliberate fires are excluded. If the fire spread to a neighbour's property, your liability cover would apply.

faqs.question: Is theft covered by my home insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes. Break-in theft is covered, including damage caused during forced entry. You must report the theft to police within 24 hours and obtain a crime reference number. Items stolen from unlocked or open properties may not be covered.

faqs.question: Is my bicycle covered if stolen outside?
faqs.answer: Bicycle theft outside the home requires the optional Außenversicherung (outside cover) extension. If you have this, your bicycle is covered up to EUR 1,000 if secured with a lock. Check your policy schedule to confirm if this extension is included.

faqs.question: Are valuables like jewellery and watches covered?
faqs.answer: Standard contents policies cover jewellery and watches up to EUR 2,000 total. For high-value items above this, you need a separately listed Wertsachen (valuables) extension. Items should be appraised and listed individually for full replacement value.

faqs.question: Is storm damage covered?
faqs.answer: Yes. Storm and hail damage to your property and contents is covered from wind speeds of Beaufort scale 8 or above. This includes broken windows, damaged roof tiles, and water entry caused by storm damage. Normal rain entering through open windows is not covered.

faqs.question: Does my policy cover broken windows?
faqs.answer: Glass breakage for windows, glass doors, and ceramic hobs is covered under the Glasbruch extension. If you have this extension, accidental glass breakage is covered. Without it, only storm or break-in related glass damage is covered.

faqs.question: Is flood damage covered?
faqs.answer: Standard policies do not include flood cover from external water sources such as rivers, groundwater, or surface water. Separate Elementarschäden (natural hazard) cover is available as an extension and covers flooding, earthquakes, landslides, and snow pressure.

faqs.question: What is the sum insured for my contents?
faqs.answer: Your sum insured is stated on your policy schedule. For standard policies we use EUR 650 per square metre of living space as a guideline. If your contents exceed this, you can increase the sum insured. Underinsurance may result in reduced claim payouts.

faqs.question: Are my electronics covered against accidental damage?
faqs.answer: Accidental damage to electronics requires the Elektronikversicherung extension. Without it, only fire, water, and theft damage to electronics is covered. With the extension, drops, spills, and screen cracks are also covered.

faqs.question: How do I file a claim?
faqs.answer: You can file a claim online at mypolicy.allianz-direct.de, by calling this line, or by email to schaden@allianz-direct.de. You need your policy number, the date of the incident, a description of what happened, and photos if available. Claims are acknowledged within 2 business days.

faqs.question: What documents do I need to file a claim?
faqs.answer: For most claims you need: your policy number, incident date and description, photos of the damage, and receipts or proof of ownership for damaged items. For theft claims you also need a police crime reference number. For water damage, a plumber's report helps speed up processing.

faqs.question: Can I file a claim by phone?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can file your claim by calling our claims line. We will take your details, issue you a claim reference number, and send a confirmation email with next steps. Our claims team is available Monday to Friday 8am to 8pm and Saturday 9am to 5pm.

faqs.question: How long does claim processing take?
faqs.answer: Standard claims are processed within 10 to 15 business days of receiving all required documents. Complex claims above EUR 5,000 may take up to 30 days. Emergency repairs can be pre-approved within 24 hours. You will receive email updates throughout.

faqs.question: Can I get emergency repairs approved quickly?
faqs.answer: Yes. For urgent situations such as a burst pipe flooding your home, call our emergency line and we can pre-authorise repairs within hours. Keep all receipts from emergency contractors as these will be reimbursed. Do not wait for formal claim approval before making emergency repairs.

faqs.question: How do I check the status of my claim?
faqs.answer: You can check your claim status online in your customer portal, or call this line and quote your claim reference number. Email updates are sent at each stage: acknowledgement, assessment, decision, and payment.

faqs.question: How is a claim payout calculated?
faqs.answer: Payouts are calculated based on replacement value minus your deductible. For contents, we pay the current market replacement cost for equivalent items. For older items we may apply a depreciation factor. Your policy schedule shows your deductible amount.

faqs.question: Will my premium increase after a claim?
faqs.answer: Claiming does not automatically increase your premium. Premiums are reviewed annually at renewal. A claim may be one factor in the review, particularly if multiple claims are made within one year. We will always notify you of any premium change before renewal.

faqs.question: What is my deductible?
faqs.answer: Your deductible is shown on your policy schedule. Standard home contents policies have a EUR 250 deductible. Building policies typically have EUR 500. You can choose a higher deductible to reduce your premium.

faqs.question: My claim was rejected. What can I do?
faqs.answer: If your claim was rejected, you will have received a letter explaining the reason. You have the right to appeal within 30 days by writing to our claims review team. If you remain unhappy after the appeal, you can contact the Insurance Ombudsman (Versicherungsombudsmann) free of charge.

faqs.question: Can I choose my own contractor for repairs?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can use your own contractor for repairs. We recommend getting at least two quotes for work above EUR 500. Send us the quotes before work starts for larger repairs. We also have a network of approved contractors who can be arranged directly.

faqs.question: My phone was stolen. How do I claim?
faqs.answer: Report the theft to police immediately and obtain a crime reference number. Then file your claim with us including the crime reference, proof of purchase, and model details of the phone. If you have the optional portable electronics cover, phones stolen outside the home are also covered.

faqs.question: Why has my premium increased?
faqs.answer: Premiums are reviewed annually and may change due to: market-wide cost increases, changes to your risk profile, claims history, or updates to your coverage. A full breakdown is included in your renewal notice, sent 6 weeks before renewal. You can call us to discuss the increase.

faqs.question: How can I reduce my premium?
faqs.answer: You can reduce your premium by: choosing a higher deductible, removing optional extensions you do not need, installing a security alarm (up to 10% discount), or paying annually instead of monthly. Call us to review your coverage and find savings.

faqs.question: How can I change my payment method?
faqs.answer: You can update your payment method in your online customer portal under Account Settings, or call us. We accept direct debit (SEPA), credit card, and annual bank transfer. Changes take effect from the next billing cycle.

faqs.question: When is my next payment due?
faqs.answer: Your payment date is shown on your policy schedule and in your online portal. Monthly payments are typically collected on the 1st or 15th of each month depending on your start date. You will receive a payment reminder 5 days before each collection.

faqs.question: I missed a payment. What happens?
faqs.answer: If a payment fails, we will retry within 5 days and send you a notification. If the retry also fails, your policy enters a grace period of 14 days during which cover remains active. After the grace period, cover may be suspended until payment is received. Contact us immediately to arrange payment.

faqs.question: Can I pay monthly instead of annually?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monthly payment is available with a small surcharge of approximately 3 to 5% annually. Annual payment is cheaper overall. You can switch between payment frequencies at your next renewal date.

faqs.question: Where can I find my invoice?
faqs.answer: All invoices and payment receipts are available in your online customer portal under Documents. You can also request a copy by email or post. Annual invoices are sent by email at the start of each policy year.

faqs.question: Am I entitled to a refund if I cancel mid-year?
faqs.answer: If you cancel your policy mid-year, you are entitled to a pro-rata refund for the unused portion of the premium, minus any claims paid. The refund is processed within 14 days to your original payment method. A small cancellation administration fee may apply.

faqs.question: How does automatic renewal work?
faqs.answer: Your policy renews automatically each year unless you cancel. You receive a renewal notice 6 weeks before the renewal date showing any premium or coverage changes. If you take no action, the policy renews on the same terms. You can cancel before renewal with 4 weeks written notice.

faqs.question: How do I cancel at renewal?
faqs.answer: To cancel at renewal, send written notice by email or post at least 4 weeks before the renewal date. The renewal date is on your policy schedule. You can also cancel through your online portal. There is no fee for cancelling at renewal.

faqs.question: Can I change my coverage at renewal?
faqs.answer: Yes. Renewal is the ideal time to update your coverage. You can add or remove extensions, change your sum insured, or update your address. Changes requested before the renewal date take effect from the renewal. Call us or log into your portal to make changes.

faqs.question: How do I cancel my policy?
faqs.answer: You can cancel at annual renewal with 4 weeks written notice. Immediate cancellation is also possible if you sell your home or there is a major change in your circumstances. Send a signed email or letter to kuendigung@allianz-direct.de with your policy number and the requested cancellation date.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my policy at any time?
faqs.answer: You have a 14-day cooling-off period from the policy start date during which you can cancel for a full refund. After this period, you can cancel at the annual renewal date with 4 weeks notice, or immediately if there is a significant change in circumstances such as moving home.

faqs.question: What does my contents insurance cover?
faqs.answer: Contents insurance covers your personal belongings inside the home against fire, water damage, storm, theft, and vandalism. This includes furniture, clothing, electronics, jewellery up to EUR 2,000, and sports equipment. Items owned by other household members are also covered.

faqs.question: What is not covered by my policy?
faqs.answer: Standard exclusions include: gradual wear and tear, maintenance issues, cosmetic damage, items left in unattended vehicles, motor vehicles, and damage caused deliberately by you. Flooding from external sources is also excluded unless you have the Elementarschäden extension.

faqs.question: I am moving home. Do I need to update my policy?
faqs.answer: Yes. You must notify us of your new address before you move. Your premium may change based on the risk profile of your new location. Coverage for your belongings during the move itself can be arranged as a short-term extension. Call us at least 2 weeks before your move date.

faqs.question: Does my insurance cover belongings during a house move?
faqs.answer: Standard policies do not cover belongings in transit during a move. We can add a temporary transit extension for your moving day. Professional removal companies also carry their own liability cover. Contact us 2 weeks before your move to arrange this.

faqs.question: I am renting. Do I need contents insurance?
faqs.answer: As a tenant, your landlord's building insurance does not cover your personal belongings. Contents insurance is highly recommended to protect your furniture, electronics, clothing, and valuables. Our tenant-specific policies start from around EUR 5 per month.

faqs.question: Does my policy cover family members living with me?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your contents policy covers all members of your household living at the insured address, including your partner, children, and other relatives. Students temporarily living away from home for studies are also covered for items taken to their student accommodation.

faqs.question: Are items in storage or a cellar covered?
faqs.answer: Items stored within your insured property, including cellars and storage rooms, are covered. Items stored externally in a rented storage unit are not covered under standard policies. A storage extension can be added — contact us for a quote.

faqs.question: What does personal liability insurance cover?
faqs.answer: Haftpflichtversicherung covers you for accidental damage or injury you cause to third parties. For example, if your child breaks a neighbour's window, or your dog bites someone, or you accidentally damage someone's property. Legal defence costs are also included.

faqs.question: If my dog damages someone's property, am I covered?
faqs.answer: Dog owners require separate Tierhalterhaftpflicht (pet liability) insurance for dog-related incidents. If you have this extension or a separate policy, third-party damage caused by your dog is covered. Some breeds classified as dangerous may require a specialist policy.

faqs.question: Am I covered if I accidentally injure someone?
faqs.answer: Yes. Personal liability insurance covers bodily injury caused accidentally to third parties. This includes medical costs, loss of earnings, and pain and suffering claims made against you. Cover limits are typically EUR 10 million or more.

faqs.question: Does liability insurance cover damage I cause at work?
faqs.answer: Personal liability insurance covers private activities only. Damage caused in the course of your employment is the responsibility of your employer. Self-employed individuals need a separate Betriebshaftpflicht (business liability) policy.

faqs.question: I accidentally damaged my landlord's property. Am I covered?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tenant liability is included in personal liability policies. If you accidentally damage your rented apartment — for example dropping something heavy on the floor or causing water damage — your liability policy covers the landlord's repair costs.

faqs.question: Do you offer travel insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer single-trip and annual multi-trip travel insurance covering medical emergencies, trip cancellation, luggage, and travel delays. Annual policies cover unlimited trips within Europe or worldwide. Contact us or visit our website for a quote.

faqs.question: Does my home insurance cover belongings when I travel?
faqs.answer: The outside cover extension (Außenversicherung) of your home policy covers portable items such as laptops, cameras, and luggage outside the home up to 10% of your sum insured. For full travel cover including medical emergencies, separate travel insurance is recommended.

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: Our customer service team is available Monday to Friday 8am to 8pm and Saturday 9am to 5pm. Our claims emergency line is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. You can also manage your policy online at any time through your customer portal.

faqs.question: How can I contact you?
faqs.answer: You can reach us by phone on this line, by email at service@allianz-direct.de, or through your online customer portal. For claims emergencies, call our 24-hour line. For written complaints, write to our registered office in Munich.

faqs.question: How do I access my online customer portal?
faqs.answer: Go to mypolicy.allianz-direct.de and log in with your email and password. If you have not registered yet, click Register and use your policy number and postcode to verify your identity. In the portal you can view your policy, make changes, file claims, and download documents.

faqs.question: How do I make a complaint?
faqs.answer: We take complaints seriously. You can write to our complaints team at beschwerde@allianz-direct.de or by post. We will acknowledge within 2 business days and respond fully within 8 weeks. If you are not satisfied, you can contact the Insurance Ombudsman (Versicherungsombudsmann) free of charge.

faqs.question: What is the Insurance Ombudsman?
faqs.answer: The Versicherungsombudsmann is an independent body that mediates disputes between insurance customers and companies free of charge. You can contact them at versicherungsombudsmann.de after you have first raised your complaint with us. Their decisions are binding on insurers for claims up to EUR 10,000.

faqs.question: How do I get a new insurance policy?
faqs.answer: You can get a quote and take out a new policy online at allianz-direct.de, by calling this line, or by email. Our online calculator gives you an instant quote in under 5 minutes. New policies can start from the same day in most cases.

faqs.question: Where can I find my policy documents?
faqs.answer: All your policy documents including your policy schedule, terms and conditions, and previous correspondence are available in your online customer portal under Documents. You can also request paper copies by calling us or sending an email.

faqs.question: Frozen pipes burst and flooded my basement. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Stop the water supply immediately if possible. Document the damage with photos before cleaning up. Call a plumber and keep all receipts. Then file a claim with us — frozen pipe damage is covered under Leitungswasser. Emergency repair costs can be pre-authorised by calling our claims line.

faqs.question: Can I increase my sum insured?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can increase your sum insured at any time, not just at renewal. The increase takes effect immediately upon confirmation and your premium is adjusted pro-rata for the remaining policy year. Log into your portal or call us to make the change.

faqs.question: Do you offer any discounts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Discounts are available for: installing an approved security alarm (up to 10%), being a long-term customer, bundling home and liability insurance together, and paying annually. New customers may also qualify for introductory discounts. Call us to find out what discounts apply to you.

faqs.question: Do I need photos to file a claim?
faqs.answer: Photos are strongly recommended but not always required. They significantly speed up claim processing and reduce the risk of disputes. Take photos before cleaning up any damage. For theft claims, photos of the area of forced entry are especially important.

faqs.question: Is mould damage covered?
faqs.answer: Mould resulting directly from a covered water damage event — such as a burst pipe — is covered as part of that claim. Mould caused by condensation, poor ventilation, or gradual damp is considered a maintenance issue and is not covered.

faqs.question: Does my insurance cover home improvements and renovations?
faqs.answer: Your existing contents are covered during renovation work. However, building materials and tools brought in by contractors are not covered under your contents policy — these should be covered by the contractor's own insurance. Inform us if renovation work materially changes the property value.

faqs.question: Can I insure a second home or holiday property?
faqs.answer: Yes. Separate policies are available for second homes and holiday properties. These are rated differently from primary residences as they are unoccupied for longer periods. Contact us for a quote — you may also qualify for a multi-property discount.

faqs.question: My neighbour's pipe burst and flooded my apartment. Who pays?
faqs.answer: Your neighbour's liability insurance should cover the damage to your property. However, processing this through their insurer can be slow. We recommend filing a claim with us directly — we will pay you promptly and then recover the costs from your neighbour's insurer (subrogation).

faqs.question: Am I speaking to a human or an AI?
faqs.answer: I am InsurVoice, an AI assistant. I am not a human agent. I can help with most insurance queries, and I will connect you to a human colleague if you need something beyond my capabilities or if you prefer to speak with a person.

faqs.question: Is this conversation being recorded?
faqs.answer: This conversation is processed to generate a response but audio is not retained after the call. Conversation intent data is logged anonymously for quality purposes in line with our GDPR privacy policy. You can request our full privacy notice at datenschutz@allianz-direct.de.

faqs.question: Is subsidence or ground movement covered?
faqs.answer: Subsidence caused by shrinking clay soil is not covered under standard home policies. The optional Elementarschäden extension covers subsidence from landslide or earthquake. Structural subsidence claims are complex — a surveyor report is required.

faqs.question: Is vandalism covered?
faqs.answer: Yes. Vandalism and malicious damage by third parties is covered. You must report the incident to police and provide a crime reference number. Damage caused by tenants or household members is excluded.

faqs.question: Is damage from a power surge covered?
faqs.answer: Power surge damage to electronics is covered if caused by lightning. Standard power fluctuations from the grid are not covered unless you have the electronics extension. A lightning strike must be evidenced, typically through a weather report.

faqs.question: A tree fell on my roof. Am I covered?
faqs.answer: Yes. Damage caused by falling trees or branches during a storm event is covered. The damage to your property is covered regardless of whether the tree was yours or a neighbour's. The cost of removing the tree itself may not be covered unless it has caused insured damage.

faqs.question: Is snow or ice damage covered?
faqs.answer: Damage caused by the weight of snow on roofs or gutters is covered under the Elementarschäden extension. Standard policies cover storm damage but not snow load specifically. Check your policy schedule for this extension.

faqs.question: Does my contents insurance cover damage caused by my pets?
faqs.answer: Damage caused by your own pets — such as a dog chewing furniture or a cat scratching floors — is not covered. Pet damage is considered wear and tear. Third-party damage caused by your pet is covered under personal liability insurance.

faqs.question: Is my home covered when it is empty for a long time?
faqs.answer: Standard policies cover unoccupied properties for up to 60 consecutive days. If your home is empty for longer — for example during renovation or a long holiday — you must notify us. Failure to do so may invalidate theft claims during that period.

faqs.question: Can I rent out my home on Airbnb while still insured?
faqs.answer: Short-term lets via platforms like Airbnb are not covered under standard home insurance. You must notify us if you rent out your property. We can arrange a landlord or short-term let extension. Guest-caused damage and theft by guests requires specialist cover.

faqs.question: Do I get a discount for having a security alarm?
faqs.answer: Yes. An approved burglar alarm can reduce your contents premium by up to 10%. The alarm must be installed by a certified company and regularly serviced. Send us the installation certificate to apply the discount. Some insurers also offer discounts for smart locks and CCTV.

faqs.question: Are solar panels on my roof covered?
faqs.answer: Solar panels fixed to your roof are covered as part of the building structure under your buildings insurance. Portable or moveable solar units are covered as contents. Damage from storms, fire, or falling objects is covered. Check whether your buildings or contents policy applies.

faqs.question: Are garden furniture and plants covered?
faqs.answer: Garden furniture and items stored in a garage or shed are covered up to 10% of your sum insured, typically up to EUR 1,500. Plants, trees, and lawns are not covered. Items stolen from an unlocked garden may not be covered.

faqs.question: Are paintings and artwork covered?
faqs.answer: Standard policies cover artwork and collectibles up to EUR 5,000 total. For high-value individual pieces, they should be listed separately with a professional valuation. Specialist art insurance is recommended for collections above EUR 20,000.

faqs.question: Is cash kept at home covered?
faqs.answer: Cash is covered up to EUR 500 under standard contents policies. For higher amounts, you need a specific cash extension. Cash stored in a certified safe can increase this limit. We recommend keeping large sums in a bank rather than at home.

faqs.question: Are musical instruments covered?
faqs.answer: Musical instruments are covered as personal belongings under contents insurance up to their listed value. High-value instruments above EUR 2,000 should be listed separately. For instruments used professionally, a separate professional equipment policy is needed.

faqs.question: Do I need to tell you if I am renovating?
faqs.answer: You should notify us of major renovation work that increases the property value by more than 20% or involves structural changes. Minor redecoration does not need to be reported. Renovation work may temporarily increase risk — check if additional cover is needed during works.

faqs.question: My neighbours have flooded me twice. Can I still claim?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each incident is assessed individually. Multiple claims for the same cause may lead to a requirement that you install preventive measures. We may also pursue your neighbour's insurer for recovery of costs. There is no automatic ban on claiming for repeat incidents.

faqs.question: Is sewer backup or drain overflow covered?
faqs.answer: Sewer backup causing damage inside your home is covered under standard Leitungswasser cover. External drain flooding from the public sewer network requires the Elementarschäden extension. Report the incident to your local water authority as well as to us.

faqs.question: My washing machine leaked and damaged the floor. Covered?
faqs.answer: Yes. Water escaping from a washing machine or dishwasher is covered as Leitungswasser damage. This covers damage to flooring, walls, and any contents damaged by the leak. The repair or replacement of the appliance itself is not covered — only the water damage it causes.

faqs.question: Is carbon monoxide or gas leak damage covered?
faqs.answer: Property damage caused by a gas explosion is covered under fire and explosion cover. Carbon monoxide incidents without a physical explosion or fire are more complex. Evacuation costs and emergency repairs to a faulty boiler are not typically covered. Ensure your boiler is annually serviced.

faqs.question: What happens if I am underinsured?
faqs.answer: If your sum insured is lower than the actual replacement value of your contents, we may apply a proportional reduction to your payout. For example, if you are insured for 80% of your actual value, a claim may be paid at 80% of its value. Reviewing your sum insured annually is recommended.

faqs.question: My kitchen caught fire. What are the first steps?
faqs.answer: Ensure everyone is safe and call the fire service. Do not re-enter until declared safe. Document all damage with photos before cleaning up. Call our claims line — we can pre-authorise emergency accommodation if your home is uninhabitable. Keep all receipts for emergency costs.

faqs.question: Can I get temporary accommodation while my home is repaired?
faqs.answer: Yes. If your home is uninhabitable due to a covered event such as fire or serious flood, we cover reasonable temporary accommodation costs. This is typically a hotel or rented property at a comparable standard to your home. Pre-authorise with us before booking.

faqs.question: My laptop was damaged by a drink spill. Is this covered?
faqs.answer: Accidental damage to electronics requires the Elektronikversicherung extension. If you have this, drink spill damage to a laptop is covered. Without the extension, only fire, theft, and water damage from plumbing is covered. Check your policy schedule for this extension.

faqs.question: Do I need a loss assessor or solicitor to claim?
faqs.answer: You do not need a loss assessor for standard claims. For complex or high-value claims above EUR 20,000, a loss assessor may help maximise your settlement. Note that their fees come from your payout. Contact us first — our team will guide you through the process at no cost.

faqs.question: I don't have receipts for stolen items. Can I still claim?
faqs.answer: Yes. Receipts are helpful but not always required. Alternative proof of ownership includes bank statements, credit card records, photos of the item in your home, or manufacturer serial numbers. Without any proof, claims for high-value items may be assessed at lower values.

faqs.question: I disagree with the claim settlement offer. What can I do?
faqs.answer: If you disagree with our offer, request a written explanation of how it was calculated. You can submit additional evidence or a counter-valuation. If unresolved, escalate to our internal complaints team, and then to the Versicherungsombudsmann if still unsatisfied.

faqs.question: A third party damaged my property. Do I claim through you or them?
faqs.answer: You can claim through us directly — we will pay you promptly and then recover costs from the at-fault party. Alternatively, pursue the third party directly through their liability insurer. Claiming through us is usually faster. Your no-claims discount is not affected when a third party is at fault.

faqs.question: What happens if a claim is found to be fraudulent?
faqs.answer: Insurance fraud is a serious criminal offence. If a claim is found to be fraudulent, the claim will be denied, the policy may be voided, and the matter may be referred to police. Honest mistakes about claim values are treated differently from deliberate fraud.

faqs.question: Will my claim be paid in cash or repairs?
faqs.answer: Most contents claims are paid in cash equivalent to the replacement value minus your deductible. For building damage, we often arrange repairs directly with approved contractors. You can choose a cash settlement in most cases, though some policies default to like-for-like replacement.

faqs.question: Can I board up my property after a break-in tonight?
faqs.answer: Yes. Emergency boarding up and security measures after a break-in can be arranged immediately. Call our 24-hour emergency line and we will authorise and arrange a contractor. Keep receipts if you arrange this yourself — costs are reimbursed as part of your claim.

faqs.question: What proof do I need for a water damage claim?
faqs.answer: For water damage claims: photos of the damage, a plumber's report identifying the cause, receipts for emergency repairs, and a list of damaged items with estimated values. We may send a loss adjuster for claims above EUR 2,000. The more documentation you provide, the faster the claim.

faqs.question: My claim has been delayed for weeks. What can I do?
faqs.answer: If your claim has been open for more than 15 business days without a decision, you can escalate to our claims supervisor. Request an update in writing. If you are still unhappy after escalation, use our formal complaints process. The Versicherungsombudsmann can be contacted after 8 weeks.

faqs.question: I was robbed while travelling abroad. Can I claim?
faqs.answer: If you have the optional Außenversicherung (outside cover) extension, portable items are covered worldwide. Without it, only theft inside your home is covered. For medical emergencies and travel disruption, you need separate travel insurance.

faqs.question: Do I get new for old replacement or market value?
faqs.answer: Our standard contents policies provide new-for-old replacement for items less than 5 years old. Older items may be subject to depreciation, particularly clothing and soft furnishings. High-value electronics are usually replaced with equivalent modern models.

faqs.question: Can I make multiple claims in one year?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can make as many claims as needed. There is no cap on the number of claims per year. However, multiple claims may be reviewed at renewal and could affect your premium. Each claim is assessed against your deductible individually.

faqs.question: How does SEPA direct debit work?
faqs.answer: SEPA direct debit automatically collects your premium from your bank account on the agreed payment date. You authorise this once when you set up the policy. You will receive advance notice of each collection. You can cancel or change the mandate at any time through your bank or by contacting us.

faqs.question: Is insurance premium tax included in my premium?
faqs.answer: Yes. All premiums quoted include the applicable insurance premium tax (Versicherungsteuer) of 19%. Your invoice shows the net premium and tax separately. Premium tax is non-negotiable and set by German law.

faqs.question: Is it cheaper to pay annually?
faqs.answer: Yes. Paying annually saves approximately 3 to 5% compared to monthly payments. Monthly payment includes a small instalment surcharge. If you switch from monthly to annual, the change takes effect at your next renewal date.

faqs.question: Can I change my payment date?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can request a change to your monthly payment date. We offer collection on the 1st, 8th, 15th, or 22nd of the month. Request the change at least 10 days before your next collection date to take effect that month.

faqs.question: Do you accept credit card payments?
faqs.answer: Yes. We accept Visa and Mastercard for annual premium payments. Credit card payments are not available for monthly direct debit. A small card processing fee may apply for credit card transactions.

faqs.question: Do you offer a no-claims discount?
faqs.answer: We do not operate a traditional no-claims discount system. Instead, claims history is one factor reviewed at annual renewal. Long-term customers with no claims typically benefit from stable or reduced premiums at renewal.

faqs.question: I think I have been overcharged. What should I do?
faqs.answer: If you believe your premium is incorrect, contact our billing team with your policy number and the amount you were charged. We will review within 5 business days. If an error is confirmed, you will receive a refund or credit to your next payment.

faqs.question: Can I suspend my policy temporarily?
faqs.answer: Insurance policies cannot be suspended and restarted — cover must be continuous. If you need to cancel, you can take out a new policy when needed. For empty properties, we offer reduced-cover options. Contact us to discuss your specific situation.

faqs.question: Can I pay in a foreign currency?
faqs.answer: All premiums are charged in Euros. We do not accept foreign currency payments. If your bank account is in a foreign currency, your bank will convert at their exchange rate and standard SEPA rules apply.

faqs.question: Do you offer discounts for insuring multiple properties?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer a multi-property discount of up to 8% when you insure two or more properties with us. This applies to home contents and building policies. Contact us to apply the discount — it is not automatically applied when taking out a second policy.

faqs.question: When does my policy start?
faqs.answer: Your policy start date is shown on your policy schedule. New policies taken out online can start from today. We will send you a welcome email with your policy documents within 2 hours of purchase. Cover begins from the start date and time shown on your schedule.

faqs.question: Can I get proof of insurance for my landlord?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can download a proof of insurance letter from your online portal, or we can send one by email. This confirms your policy number, coverage type, and validity dates. We can usually provide this within minutes of your request.

faqs.question: How do I add or remove coverage extensions?
faqs.answer: You can add or remove extensions online in your customer portal, or by calling us. Changes take effect immediately and your premium is adjusted pro-rata. Some extensions can only be added at renewal — our team can advise what is possible mid-term.

faqs.question: My child is going to university. Are their belongings covered?
faqs.answer: Yes. Contents insurance typically covers students' belongings taken to their university accommodation, up to 20% of the sum insured. This covers items like laptops, phones, and clothing. Expensive items above EUR 1,000 should be listed separately.

faqs.question: Can I add another person to my policy?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can add a co-policyholder such as your partner to your policy. Their belongings are then also covered. There may be a small premium adjustment. Contact us to make this change — we will need their name and date of birth.

faqs.question: I inherited a property. Can I insure it?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inherited properties can be insured from the date of inheritance. Contact us with the property details and we will arrange cover. If the property is unoccupied, an unoccupied property policy may be needed. Standard policies cover up to 60 days of vacancy.

faqs.question: Can a married couple share one policy?
faqs.answer: Yes. A joint policy covers both partners and all household members at the insured address. Both partners are named on the policy and can make changes or file claims. Joint policies are standard for households — no separate policies are needed for family members living together.

faqs.question: Are policy documents available in English?
faqs.answer: Policy documents are currently available in German. An English summary of key terms can be provided on request. For full translation, independent translation services are recommended. Our customer service team can explain policy terms by phone in simple language.

faqs.question: Can I cancel within 14 days?
faqs.answer: Yes. You have a 14-day cooling-off period from the policy start date. If you cancel within this period, you receive a full refund of premiums paid, with no charges. After 14 days, standard cancellation terms apply.

faqs.question: Can I transfer my policy to a new address?
faqs.answer: Yes. When you move home, your policy can be transferred to your new address. Your premium may change based on the risk profile of the new location. Contact us at least 2 weeks before your move to arrange the transfer. Cover for your belongings during the move can also be added.

faqs.question: Can I choose a different deductible?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can choose a higher deductible to reduce your premium. Typical deductible options are EUR 250, EUR 500, or EUR 1,000. A higher deductible means you pay more out of pocket when claiming but your annual premium is lower. You cannot change your deductible mid-term.

faqs.question: Can I use my home policy for a home office?
faqs.answer: Contents used for home office work — such as a personal laptop — are covered. However, business equipment owned by your employer or your business, and business stock, are not covered under personal home insurance. A home business extension is available.

faqs.question: How do I get my claims history?
faqs.answer: You can view your claims history in your online customer portal. A formal claims history letter — often needed when switching insurers — can be requested by calling us or emailing service@allianz-direct.de. We will send this within 5 business days.

faqs.question: I want to switch from another insurer to you. Is that easy?
faqs.answer: Switching is simple. You can cancel your existing policy at its renewal date and start a new policy with us. We can match your current coverage level and often improve on the price. Your claims history from your previous insurer may be requested. Get a quote at allianz-direct.de.

faqs.question: My policy lapsed. Can I reinstate it?
faqs.answer: If your policy lapsed due to non-payment within the last 30 days, reinstatement may be possible by settling the outstanding balance. After 30 days, a new policy application is required. Any claims made during a lapsed period are not covered.

faqs.question: My child accidentally broke a neighbour's window. Am I liable?
faqs.answer: Yes. Parents are liable for accidental damage caused by their minor children. Personal liability insurance covers this. Report the incident to us and we will handle the claim with your neighbour's property insurer or directly with your neighbour.

faqs.question: Am I covered for injuries I cause during sport?
faqs.answer: Personal liability insurance covers accidental injuries to third parties during most recreational sports. Professional sports and motor sports are excluded. If you play contact sports regularly, check the specific exclusions in your policy schedule.

faqs.question: Am I covered if my drone damages someone's property?
faqs.answer: Drones are classified as unmanned aircraft. Personal liability insurance typically excludes aircraft. Separate drone liability insurance is required if you operate a drone. This is also legally required in Germany for drones above 250g under EU regulations.

faqs.question: A guest was injured in my home. Am I covered?
faqs.answer: Yes. If a guest is injured in your home due to your negligence — for example, a loose stair that you knew about — your liability insurance covers their medical costs and compensation. Accidents with no negligence on your part may not trigger liability.

faqs.question: I am renting out a room. Does liability cover my tenant?
faqs.answer: Personal liability insurance covers accidental damage you cause to others. It does not cover your tenant's personal liability claims. Tenants should have their own personal liability policy. If you rent out a room, a landlord liability extension may be needed.

faqs.question: Does liability insurance cover incidents abroad?
faqs.answer: Yes. Personal liability insurance typically covers incidents in all EU countries and many worldwide. Check your policy schedule for the geographic scope. For incidents outside the EU, a travel insurance policy with liability cover is recommended.

faqs.question: Am I covered for liability as a volunteer?
faqs.answer: Personal liability insurance covers private activities including voluntary work for non-profit organisations in most cases. Professional volunteer roles with significant responsibilities may require specific organisational liability cover. Check with the organisation.

faqs.question: Is car damage I cause covered under liability?
faqs.answer: Damage caused by your motor vehicle requires separate motor liability insurance (Kfz-Haftpflicht), which is mandatory in Germany. Personal liability insurance explicitly excludes incidents involving motor vehicles. Ensure your car insurance is up to date.

faqs.question: Does liability insurance pay for a lawyer if I am sued?
faqs.answer: Yes. Legal defence costs are included in personal liability insurance. If a third party sues you for damages, we cover the cost of a lawyer to defend you, court fees, and any awarded damages up to your policy limit, typically EUR 10 million or more.

faqs.question: Am I covered for defamation or copyright claims online?
faqs.answer: Standard personal liability policies do not cover online defamation, copyright infringement, or cyber incidents. Private cyber insurance is a separate product that covers these risks. This is an increasingly important cover as online activities grow.

faqs.question: How long is the wait time to speak to an agent?
faqs.answer: Current average wait time is 2 to 4 minutes during business hours. Mondays and the days after public holidays are busiest. Outside business hours you can leave a callback request and we will call you back within 2 hours of opening. You can also get help through our online portal 24/7.

faqs.question: Can I request a callback?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can request a callback through our website or customer portal at any time. We will call you back within 2 hours during business hours. Specify your preferred callback time and the topic you need help with so we can prepare.

faqs.question: What data do you hold about me?
faqs.answer: We hold your personal details, policy information, claims history, and payment records. You have the right to request a copy of all data we hold (Subject Access Request). Submit your request to datenschutz@allianz-direct.de. We will respond within 30 days.

faqs.question: Can I request deletion of my personal data?
faqs.answer: You can request deletion of your personal data under GDPR's right to erasure. However, we are legally required to retain certain records — such as claims history — for up to 10 years. Submit your request to datenschutz@allianz-direct.de and we will process it within 30 days.

faqs.question: Do I need a broker or can I buy directly?
faqs.answer: You can buy directly from us online, by phone, or by email — no broker needed. Direct policies are often cheaper as there is no commission. If you prefer independent advice comparing multiple insurers, a licensed broker can help. We also work with selected broker partners.

faqs.question: Can I speak to someone in German?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our customer service team speaks German and English. German is our primary language. For other languages, we can arrange an interpreter in some cases — please let us know your language preference when you call.

faqs.question: Where can I leave a review?
faqs.answer: We welcome your feedback on Google Reviews, Trustpilot, and the App Store. You can also send feedback directly to feedback@allianz-direct.de. Customer feedback helps us improve our services.

faqs.question: Who owns Allianz Direct?
faqs.answer: Allianz Direct is a fully digital direct insurer and part of the Allianz Group, one of the world's largest insurance companies. We operate in multiple European markets. Our German entity is regulated by BaFin, the Federal Financial Supervisory Authority.

faqs.question: Are you regulated?
faqs.answer: Yes. Allianz Direct is regulated by BaFin (Bundesanstalt für Finanzdienstleistungsaufsicht), the German financial supervisory authority. Our policies comply with all applicable German and EU insurance regulations including Solvency II and the Insurance Distribution Directive.

faqs.question: What is the emergency number?
faqs.answer: Our 24-hour emergency claims line is available around the clock for urgent situations such as fire, flood, or break-in. You can find the number on your policy schedule and in your customer portal. For life-threatening emergencies, always call 112 first.

faqs.question: Do you have a mobile app?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Allianz Direct app is available for iOS and Android. Through the app you can view your policy, file claims, download documents, and contact customer service. Search for Allianz Direct in the App Store or Google Play.

faqs.question: How do I get a quote?
faqs.answer: You can get an instant quote online at allianz-direct.de in under 5 minutes. Enter your address, property details, and the coverage you need. Alternatively, call us and we will prepare a quote over the phone. Quotes are valid for 30 days.

faqs.question: Can my partner be added to the policy?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can add your partner as a co-policyholder so that both of you can manage the policy and make claims. There is usually no additional premium for adding a partner. Contact us with their name and date of birth to make this change.

faqs.question: The policyholder has passed away. What do we do?
faqs.answer: We are sorry for your loss. The policy can be transferred to a family member or cancelled. Contact us with a copy of the death certificate and we will guide you through the process. Outstanding claims can still be paid to the estate. There are no fees for handling this situation.

faqs.question: Can I go paperless?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can opt for paperless communication in your customer portal under Account Settings. All documents, invoices, and correspondence will be sent by email. You can switch back to paper at any time. Paperless customers sometimes qualify for small discounts.
